verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework where tools must be defined via createTool() with zod-based inputSchema/outputSchema, giving compile-time and runtime schema validation for tool calls (mastra-docs-2, mastra-docs-14, mastra-docs-1). This supports agents catching malformed tool calls early, but there's no evidence of broader build-time validation across agent workflows, memory, or outputs beyond tool schemas, nor independent corroboration of this specific capability. Missing for 10: evidence of end-to-end static type checking across workflows/agents, independent/hands-on confirmation that type errors are caught at build time, and validation coverage beyond tool inputs/outputs.
